subject: Physics
text: A block of mass $m = 5 kg$ is kept on the inclined plane as shown in the figure. Calculate the friction force. Assume $g = 10 m/s^2$.
solution: Friction force is $mg \sin(\theta)$. As shown in image, $\theta = 30^\circ$.

subject: Mathematics
solution: Using Wallis' formula or gamma function, the answer is $\frac{\pi}{4} \approx 0.785$.
